complete_retrieval_artifact_audit.source: complete verified published ANEMONE retrieval metadata; no inferred names, geocoding or external sources
complete_retrieval_artifact_audit.non_control_policy: exclude is_control IS TRUE; retain NULL/unknown classification and disclose it

maximum_pairwise_great_circle_span.definition: maximum haversine distance over all 216 distinct valid non-control recorded positions; mean spherical Earth radius 6371.0088 km; grid-position diagnostic, not surveyed site distance

geographic_names.interpretation: The published retrieval artifact provides no populated authoritative bay/station fields or geographic-name metadata. It contains canonical source IDs, hashes and row references, but not full raw sample metadata. Provider project/run IDs and source sample labels must not be parsed into geographic area names. No named-area count can be established from this artifact.

recommendations.named_areas: Answer that named-area metadata is not supplied in the published evidence. Report the 216 recorded grid-coordinate positions as a separate count with its definition; do not substitute it for a count of named areas. Exact source-provided geographic names would require inspecting retained raw/canonical source metadata separately.
recommendations.same_area: Use the exact geographic extent and approximate maximum separation to describe broad coverage of the complete catalogue; distinguish this from the fixed Miyagi example cohort. Do not invent bay, country or region names.

geography_contract.area_scope: Canonical source aggregate only; no claim that no separate research registry or upstream area labels can exist.
geography_contract.distance: Great-circle separation of the actual latitude-extreme positions, not a global maximum pairwise distance or continuous sampled coverage.
geography_contract.reuse: Demo-only immutable scientific snapshot; exact filters, metric, v3, payload hash and all three publication heads with fresh heads/pointer rechecks. No mutable research-registry availability is represented.
